title: Should I bring an umbrella today with a 40% chance of rain
summary: Bring it if getting wet would ruin your day; leave it if you do not mind a light soaking.

blocks.title: Bring the umbrella if getting wet would bother you; otherwise leave it
blocks.body: Forty percent means rain is plausible, not certain. The useful question is cost of being wrong wet versus wrong dry — not whether the forecast is precise.
